class Bridge:
    READ_COMMANDS = {
        "app.ping", "catalog.get_channels", "catalog.get_banners",
        "catalog.get_video_list", "catalog.search_video", "catalog.get_video_key",
        "catalog.get_video_detail", "catalog.get_channel_detail", "video.play",
    }

    def __init__(self, app_dir):
        if os.name != "nt":
            raise RuntimeError("The installed bridge requires Windows x64 Python")
        self.app_dir = Path(app_dir).resolve(strict=True)
        self.dll_path = self.app_dir / "electron_bridge.dll"
        if not self.dll_path.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("electron_bridge.dll is missing from the selected application")
        self.state_root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dmghg-headless-"))
        os.environ["DMGHG_TEST_DATA_ROOT"] = str(self.state_root)
        os.environ["RUST_LOG"] = "error"
        self.dll = ctypes.CDLL(str(self.dll_path))
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_string_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.version = installed_version(self.app_dir / "dmghg.exe")
        self.handle = self.dll.dmghg_service_new(b"dmghg-flutter", self.version.encode("ascii"))
        if not self.handle:
            raise RuntimeError("The installed bridge could not initialize")

    def call(self, command, payload=None):
        if command not in self.READ_COMMANDS:
            raise ValueError("Command is outside the inspection allowlist")
        request = {"request_id": "headless-inspection", "protocol_version": 1,
                   "command": command, "payload": payload or {}}
        with self.lock:
            previous = Path.cwd()
            try:
                # The installed Lua resolver loads resources/lua relative to Cwd.
                os.chdir(self.app_dir)
                ptr = self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json(
                    self.handle, json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))
                if not ptr:
                    raise RuntimeError("Bridge returned a null response")

                    response = json.loads(ctypes.string_at(ptr).decode("utf-8"))
                finally:

            finally:
                os.chdir(previous)
        if response.get("ok") is not True:
            error = response.get("error", {})
            raise RuntimeError(f"{error.get('code')}: {error.get('message')}")
        return response.get("data")

    def close(self):
        if self.handle:
            self.dll.dmghg_service_free(self.handle)

def installed_version(exe):
    """Read PE version metadata; the resolver rejects unsupported client versions."""
    version = ctypes.windll.version
    size = version.GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(str(exe), None)
    if not size:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot read the installed application's version metadata")
    buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
    if not version.GetFileVersionInfoW(str(exe), 0, size, buffer):
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot read application version info")
    info = ctypes.c_void_p()
    length = ctypes.c_uint()
    if not version.VerQueryValueW(buffer, "\\", ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.byref(length)):
        raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is missing")
    fields = ctypes.cast(info, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32))
    if fields[0] != 0xFEEF04BD or length.value < 52:
        raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is invalid")
    return f"{fields[2] >> 16}.{fields[2] & 65535}.{fields[3] >> 16}"


def inspect(bridge, keyword):
    channels = bridge.call("catalog.get_channels")
    listing = bridge.call("catalog.get_video_list", {"page": 1})
    search = bridge.call("catalog.search_video", {"key": keyword, "page": "1"})
    videos = listing.get("items", [])
    if not channels or not videos or not search.get("items"):
        raise RuntimeError("Empty channel/list/search response; cannot certify a rule")
    selected = search["items"][0]
    detail = bridge.call("catalog.get_video_detail", {"id": str(selected["id"])})
    groups = detail.get("parts", [])
    episodes = sum(len(group.get("part", [])) for group in groups)
    if not episodes:
        raise RuntimeError("No real episodes in the detail response")
    group = next(g for g in groups if g.get("part"))
    payload = {"id": str(selected["id"]), "part": group["part"][0], "play": group["play"], "resolve": True}
    play = bridge.call("video.play", payload)
    variant = play["list"][play["default"]]
    media = media_probe(variant["url"], variant.get("headers"))
    return {
        "application": str(bridge.app_dir),
        "dll_sha256": hashlib.sha256(bridge.dll_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "no_desktop": True, "installed_version": bridge.version,
        "isolated_state_root": str(bridge.state_root),
        "channels": len(channels), "list_items": len(videos),
        "search_keyword": keyword, "search_items": len(search["items"]),
        "detail_id": selected["id"], "detail_title": detail.get("name"),
        "episode_count": episodes, "play_variants": len(play["list"]),
        "media": media, "mobile_standalone_verified": False,
        "dependency": "Windows installed electron_bridge.dll and resources/lua",
    }, play


def media_probe(url, headers=None, depth=0):
    """Check actual bytes, never equate a play URL string with successful media."""
    request = Request(url, headers={**(headers or {}), "Range": "bytes=0-2047"})
    with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
        chunk = response.read(2048)
        report = {"host": urlsplit(response.url).hostname, "status": response.status,
                "content_type": response.headers.get("Content-Type"), "bytes_read": len(chunk),
                "hls_manifest": chunk.lstrip().startswith(b"#EXTM3U")}
        if report["hls_manifest"] and depth < 2:
            text = chunk.decode("utf-8", "replace")
            uris = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")]
            if uris:
                report["first_child"] = media_probe(urljoin(response.url, uris[0]), headers, depth + 1)
        return report


def classify_decoder_warning(text):
    """Return categories, excluding URLs before classifying warnings."""
    text = re.sub(r'https?://\S+', '[URL]', text.lower())
    codes = set()
    for status in ['403', '404']:
        if re.search(r'(?:http(?: error)?|server returned|status(?: code)?)\D{0,12}' + status + r'\b', text):
            codes.add('http_' + status)
    for pattern, code in [(r'\b(?:tls|ssl)\b|gnutls|schannel', 'tls_error'),
        (r'timed out|timeout', 'network_timeout'), (r'failed to resolve|name resolution', 'resolution_error'),
        (r'failed to open', 'open_failed'), (r'connection refused', 'connection_refused')]:
        if re.search(pattern, text):
            codes.add(code)
    return codes


def decode_probe(bridge, variant, progress_seconds=0.2, deadline_seconds=16, diagnostics=False):
    """Use the installed libmpv decoder with null audio/video outputs; no window."""
    dll_dir = os.add_dll_directory(str(bridge.app_dir))
    mpv = ctypes.CDLL(str(bridge.app_dir / "libmpv-2.dll"))
    mpv.mpv_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    mpv.mpv_set_option_string.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
    mpv.mpv_initialize.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    mpv.mpv_command.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p)]
    mpv.mpv_get_property_string.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
    mpv.mpv_get_property_string.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    mpv.mpv_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    mpv.mpv_wait_event.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double]
    mpv.mpv_wait_event.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    mpv.mpv_terminate_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    if diagnostics:
        class Event(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [('event_id', ctypes.c_int), ('error', ctypes.c_int),
                        ('reply_userdata', ctypes.c_uint64), ('data', ctypes.c_void_p)]
        class LogMessage(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [('prefix', ctypes.c_char_p), ('level', ctypes.c_char_p),
                        ('text', ctypes.c_char_p), ('log_level', ctypes.c_int)]
        mpv.mpv_request_log_messages.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
    handle = mpv.mpv_create()
    if not handle:
        raise RuntimeError("The installed media decoder could not initialize")
    try:
        if diagnostics:
            mpv.mpv_request_log_messages(handle, b'warn')
        for key, value in {"vo": "null", "ao": "null", "terminal": "no", "load-scripts": "no",
                           "network-timeout": "12", "cache-secs": "2", "demuxer-max-bytes": "4M"}.items():
            if mpv.mpv_set_option_string(handle, key.encode(), value.encode()) < 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot set headless decoder option {key}")
        headers = ",".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in (variant.get("headers") or {}).items())
        if headers:
            mpv.mpv_set_option_string(handle, b"http-header-fields", headers.encode())
        if mpv.mpv_initialize(handle) < 0:
            raise RuntimeError("The installed decoder initialization failed")
        args = (ctypes.c_char_p * 4)(b"loadfile", variant["url"].encode(), b"replace", None)
        if mpv.mpv_command(handle, args) < 0:
            raise RuntimeError("The installed decoder rejected the media request")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + deadline_seconds
        facts = {}
        diagnostic_codes = set()
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            event_ptr = mpv.mpv_wait_event(handle, 0.1)
            if diagnostics and event_ptr:
                event = ctypes.cast(event_ptr, ctypes.POINTER(Event)).contents
                if event.event_id == 2 and event.data:
                    message = ctypes.cast(event.data, ctypes.POINTER(LogMessage)).contents
                    text = (message.text or b'').decode('utf-8', 'replace').lower()
                    # Emit categories only; raw messages may contain signed URLs.
                    diagnostic_codes.update(classify_decoder_warning(text))
                elif event.event_id == 7 and event.data:
                    ended = ctypes.cast(event.data, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int * 2)).contents
                    facts['end_file_reason'] = ended[0]
                    facts['end_file_error'] = ended[1]
            for key in ["audio-codec-name", "video-params/w", "video-params/h", "time-pos"]:
                ptr = mpv.mpv_get_property_string(handle, key.encode())
                if ptr:
                    try:
                        facts[key] = ctypes.string_at(ptr).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                    finally:
                        mpv.mpv_free(ptr)
            if facts.get("video-params/w") and float(facts.get("time-pos", "0")) > progress_seconds:
                break
        facts["decoded_video"] = bool(facts.get("video-params/w")) and float(facts.get("time-pos", "0")) > progress_seconds
        facts["outputs"] = {"audio": "null", "video": "null"}
        if diagnostics:
            facts['diagnostic_codes'] = sorted(diagnostic_codes)
        return facts
    finally:
        mpv.mpv_terminate_destroy(handle)
        dll_dir.close()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""动漫共和国 DMGHG v1 本地同构桥接服务 (Headless Bridge Service)

独立内聚的本地服务，桥接已安装的 electron_bridge.dll 原生服务。
仅监听 127.0.0.1 环回地址，提供只读 RPC 与 REST 路由供海阔视界 PC 运行库调用。
"""

import argparse
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import socket
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from http import HTTPStatus
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from pathlib import Path
from socketserver import ThreadingMixIn
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs


def installed_version(exe_path):
    """从 PE 元数据读取客户端版本"""
    version = ctypes.windll.version
    size = version.GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(str(exe_path), None)
    if not size:
        raise RuntimeError("无法读取目标应用的 PE 版本元数据")
    buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
    if not version.GetFileVersionInfoW(str(exe_path), 0, size, buffer):
        raise RuntimeError("无法读取应用版本信息")
    info = ctypes.c_void_p()
    length = ctypes.c_uint()
    if not version.VerQueryValueW(buffer, "\\", ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.byref(length)):
        raise RuntimeError("版本信息结构体缺失")
    fields = ctypes.cast(info, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32))
    if fields[0] != 0xFEEF04BD or length.value < 52:
        raise RuntimeError("版本信息结构体无效")
    return f"{fields[2] >> 16}.{fields[2] & 65535}.{fields[3] >> 16}"


class NativeBridge:
    """封装 electron_bridge.dll 原生接口"""
    READ_COMMANDS = {
        "app.ping",
        "catalog.get_channels",
        "catalog.get_banners",
        "catalog.get_video_list",
        "catalog.search_video",
        "catalog.get_video_key",
        "catalog.get_video_detail",
        "catalog.get_channel_detail",
        "video.play",
    }

    def __init__(self, app_dir):
        if os.name != "nt":
            raise RuntimeError("本桥接服务仅支持 Windows x64 系统")
        self.app_dir = Path(app_dir).resolve(strict=True)
        self.dll_path = self.app_dir / "electron_bridge.dll"
        if not self.dll_path.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(f"未在目标目录找到 electron_bridge.dll: {self.app_dir}")

        self.state_root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dmghg-bridge-"))
        os.environ["DMGHG_TEST_DATA_ROOT"] = str(self.state_root)
        os.environ["RUST_LOG"] = "error"

        self.dll = ctypes.CDLL(str(self.dll_path))
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_string_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.version = installed_version(self.app_dir / "dmghg.exe")
        self.handle = self.dll.dmghg_service_new(b"dmghg-flutter", self.version.encode("ascii"))
        if not self.handle:
            raise RuntimeError("原生桥接句柄初始化失败")

    def call(self, command, payload=None):
        if command not in self.READ_COMMANDS:
            raise ValueError(f"命令 '{command}' 不在只读安全白名单中")

        request = {
            "request_id": f"req-{int(time.time() * 1000)}",
            "protocol_version": 1,
            "command": command,
            "payload": payload or {}
        }

        with self.lock:
            previous = Path.cwd()
            try:
                # 原生 Lua 解析器依赖相对 Cwd 加载 resources/lua
                os.chdir(self.app_dir)
                raw_bytes = json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                ptr = self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json(self.handle, raw_bytes)
                if not ptr:
                    raise RuntimeError("原生服务返回空指针响应")
                try:
                    resp_str = ctypes.string_at(ptr).decode("utf-8")
                    response = json.loads(resp_str)
                finally:
                    self.dll.dmghg_string_free(ptr)
            finally:
                os.chdir(previous)

        if response.get("ok") is not True:
            err = response.get("error", {})
            raise RuntimeError(f"{err.get('code', 'ERR')}: {err.get('message', '未知错误')}")
        return response.get("data")

    def close(self):
        with self.lock:
            if getattr(self, "handle", None):
                try:
                    self.dll.dmghg_service_free(self.handle)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self.handle = None


class ThreadedHTTPServer(ThreadingMixIn, HTTPServer):
    """支持多线程并发处理请求的 HTTP 服务"""
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True


class BridgeRequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """桥接请求分发处理器"""
    server_version = "DMGHGBridge/1.0"
    timeout = 5  # 服务端读取超时 5 秒，留出整体时限余量

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        # 静默请求日志，避免控制台污染
        pass

    def send_json(self, status_code, data):
        body = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status_code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(HTTPStatus.NO_CONTENT)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
        path = parsed.path
        query = parse_qs(parsed.query)

        try:
            if path == "/ping":
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {
                    "ok": True,
                    "service": "dmghg-bridge",
                    "version": self.server.native_bridge.version,
                    "status": "ready"
                })
                return

            if path == "/channels":
                channels = self.server.native_bridge.call("catalog.get_channels")
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {
                    "ok": True,
                    "data": channels
                })
                return

            if path == "/list":
                channel = query.get("channel", [None])[0]
                page_str = query.get("page", ["1"])[0]
                try:
                    page = int(page_str)
                except ValueError:
                    page = 1
                payload = {"page": page}
                if channel is not None and channel != "":
                    try:
                        payload["channel"] = int(channel)
                    except ValueError:
                        payload["channel"] = channel
                data = self.server.native_bridge.call("catalog.get_video_list", payload)
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {"ok": True, "data": data})
                return

            if path == "/search":
                key = query.get("key", [query.get("keyword", [""])[0]])[0]
                page = query.get("page", ["1"])[0]
                data = self.server.native_bridge.call("catalog.search_video", {"key": key, "page": str(page)})
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {"ok": True, "data": data})
                return

            if path == "/detail":
                vid = query.get("id", [""])[0]
                if not vid:
                    self.send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"ok": False, "error": "缺少参数 id"})
                    return
                data = self.server.native_bridge.call("catalog.get_video_detail", {"id": str(vid)})
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {"ok": True, "data": data})
                return

            if path == "/play":
                vid = query.get("id", [""])[0]
                part = query.get("part", [""])[0]
                play = query.get("play", [""])[0]
                if not vid or not part or not play:
                    self.send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"ok": False, "error": "缺少必要播放参数 id/part/play"})
                    return
                payload = {
                    "id": str(vid),
                    "part": part,
                    "play": play,
                    "resolve": True
                }
                data = self.server.native_bridge.call("video.play", payload)
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {"ok": True, "data": data})
                return

            self.send_json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"ok": False, "error": f"未知路径: {path}"})
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_json(HTTPStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, {"ok": False, "error": str(e)})

    def do_POST(self):
        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
        path = parsed.path

        if path != "/call":
            self.send_json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"ok": False, "error": f"未知 POST 路由: {path}"})
            return

        try:
            content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            if content_length <= 0:
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"ok": False, "error": "请求体为空"})
                return
            if content_length > 1024 * 1024:  # 限制请求体 1MB
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"ok": False, "error": "请求体超出 1MB 限制"})
                return

            post_data = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            req_json = json.loads(post_data.decode("utf-8"))

            command = req_json.get("command")
            payload = req_json.get("payload", {})
            if not command:
                self.send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"ok": False, "error": "缺少 command 字段"})
                return

            data = self.server.native_bridge.call(command, payload)
            self.send_json(HTTPStatus.OK, {
                "ok": True,
                "command": command,
                "data": data
            })
        except ValueError as ve:
            self.send_json(HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, {"ok": False, "error": str(ve)})
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_json(HTTPStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, {"ok": False, "error": str(e)})


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="动漫共和国 DMGHG 本地无头桥接服务")
    parser.add_argument("--app-dir", required=True, help="动漫共和国安装根目录 (包含 electron_bridge.dll)")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=18002, help="本地监听端口 (默认 18002)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # 安全检查：仅允许在 18000, 18001, 18002 端口运行
    allowed_ports = {18000, 18001, 18002}
    if args.port not in allowed_ports:
        sys.stderr.write(f"错误: 端口 {args.port} 不在允许的端机引擎端口列表中 ({allowed_ports})\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    # 初始化原生桥接
    bridge = NativeBridge(args.app_dir)

    # 严格绑定 127.0.0.1 环回地址，绝不绑定 0.0.0.0 或外部网络
    server_address = ("127.0.0.1", args.port)
    httpd = ThreadedHTTPServer(server_address, BridgeRequestHandler)
    httpd.native_bridge = bridge

    print(f"DMGHG Native Bridge 服务已就绪，正在监听: [REDACTED_URL]")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n正在停止桥接服务...")
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()
        bridge.close()
        print("桥接服务已退出")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
